neighbours.label: The first word of a frozen 'X and Y' binomial ('bed and breakfast', 'cease and desist', 'trial and error'), predicting ' and', vs the same word used on its own
fire: They ran a little bed and breakfast on the coast for twenty years.
The company received a cease and desist order from the rival brand.
Grandpa kept a box of old black and white photos in the attic.
The accountant sent us the profit and loss report for March.
We learned to bake bread mostly by trial and error in the first year.
The waiter brought salt and pepper to the table with our soup.
My father still listens to rock and roll records on Sunday mornings.
Before deciding, she wrote down the pros and cons of each job offer.
quiet: They ran a little shop on the coast for twenty years and sold it.
The company received a polite letter from the rival brand last week.
Grandpa kept a black box of old photos up in the attic.
The accountant sent us the yearly report for March on time.
We learned to bake bread mostly from a book in the first year.
The waiter brought fresh bread to the table with our soup.
My father still listens to old records on Sunday mornings.
Before deciding, she wrote down the salary of each job offer.

predictions: Binomial first words 0.3-1.1; the same words outside a binomial under 0.2.
short: first word of a fixed 'X and Y' pair
notes: Card: ' black' x7, ' bed' x4 before 'and/&', ' cease', ' plug', ' Drag', ' Profit', ' Terms'; - pole promotes ' and'.
